profile_text.body:
Pegasystems Inc. is a public company headquartered in Waltham, Massachusetts, trading under the ticker PEGA. Its website describes the company as the leading AI-powered platform for enterprise transformation, saying that organizations use Pega to automate workflows, personalize customer experiences, and modernize legacy systems. The company states it has operated since 1983.

The company's AI offerings center on Pega Platform and Pega Blueprint. Pega describes its AI agents as operating with context, compliance, and human oversight from the start, and says the platform is designed for mission-critical work with governance built in. Pega Blueprint is presented as an AI-powered workspace that brings business and IT together.

Public records list the company's CIK as 0001013857. The company has 191 law exposure records in Massachusetts and no litigation cases associated with it.
